result.summary: Added describe 'scan_tracked/1 against a fixture repo' (3 tests) with a private old_scan/1 oracle and temp git-init repos (on_exit rm_rf). Combined repo: small.env, large.txt (>2.5 MB, hit line 39991), longline.txt (13k-char line, hit line 2), nulbytes.bin (NUL bytes, hit line 2), toobig.txt (>4,000,000 B, not scanned), bad.bin (invalid UTF-8, not scanned), clean.txt (blank/variable forms, scanned, no hit), untracked.env (not scanned); new == old on hits and scanned_paths and equals the absolute expectation (4 hits). Separate repos: clean-only (hits [], scanned [clean.txt]) and no-mention (git grep exit 1: both []). NUL.bin was renamed nulbytes.bin because NUL is a Windows reserved device name (git add failed). Mutant: adding -I to git grep -> 8/9 passed, combined test failed; reverted and verified (cmp + grep). Two runs 9 passed; format and compile --warnings-as-errors exit 0.
